item.title: Josh Pate has HOPE for College Football 🏈 Why Alabama WILL compete for a title in 2026
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: If Beat Everyone hits the transfer portal, we're taking a hard look at Pate State. We welcome the one and only Josh Pate to discuss Alabama's national championship prospects in 2026, plus the future of college football. What has he learned from Kalen DeBoer and just about every other high-profile head coach in the sport from his recent sitdown interviews? Are dynasties a thing of the past? Was the BCS the best way to determine a champion? Is Alabama one of the few programs who can compete for a title every year? Why is a 24-team College Football Playoff such a bad idea? Pate talks about all this and MORE!

item.title: The ULTIMATE Alabama Football DRAFT! 🏈 The Best QBs, Coaches, Games, Plays & MORE!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: It's the biggest Beat Everyone draft yet, the ULTIMATE Alabama Football Draft. For fans, what is the ultimate Alabama football experience. What is representative of your feeling, your memory, what you'd tell and show aliens if they flew down and asked you what is Alabama football? Ben Flanagan, Matt Scalici and special guest Cruz Oxenreider pick the best games, coaches, players, plays, traditions, and more. Play along, and tell us what we got wrong in the comments!
